notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) SmokeErodeBase01_FxM: unlit translucent toon smoke sprites. SOURCE: every parameter value, both textures, both static switches, blend/shading, dynamic param name 'Opacity'. TEXTURE EVIDENCE: Opacity Mask R = hard silhouette, G = hard inner region, B = soft lit relief (DarkStormcloud 2-tone texture has R/G only); NoiseTexture = SmokeErosionTile01 erosion pattern; all sRGB so sampled linearised. Noise uv = atlas TexCoord0 * NoiseTextureScale (instances pair scale 1x0.5 with the 4x2 atlas and 0.25x0.25 with 1x1, both 0.25 tile per quad). AUTHORED: erosion of the R silhouette by the FPS-stepped panned/rotated noise with particle alpha as threshold and EdgeSoftness as edge width (MF_TransluscentToonErosion graph stripped); '2 Color Mask' on = lerp(Outer, Inner, G), off = lerp(Outer, Inner, B); dyn 'Opacity' multiplies opacity; SmoothStep(DepthMin, DepthMax) on the depth-fade term; NoiseRotatorSpeed as rad/s. KNOWN LIBRARY ISSUE: materials.json stores vectors as {ParameterValue|DefaultValue: [r,g,b,a]} but fx_materials.gd _vec() only accepts arrays, so InnerColor/OuterColor overrides do not arrive yet (shader keeps root defaults 1.0 / 0.5).
